proposed.explanation: While conservative practice may reduce this capacity by 25% for moisture or load duration, the nominal capacity exceeds 4000 lbf. Not all split rings exceed 6500 lbf; smaller rings (2.5 inch) develop only 2500—3200 lbf. 6200 lbf falls within the published 5000—6500 lbf range, so it does not exceed capacity by 200 lbf. Split ring capacity reference tables show a 4-inch diameter ring with 3/4 inch bolt develops 5000—6500 lbf, placing the 6200 lbf load within acceptable range (at the upper end). Know the relationship between ring diameter, bolt size, and capacity; do not confuse nominal capacity with allowable capacity under adjusted conditions.
